# Abeta Dynamic Layout Engine

> Open-source, multi-tenant, rule-driven Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Layout Engine & Visual Layout Studio written in Go 1.26.0 with strict Clean Architecture. Emits 1:1 wire-compatible v1 contracts directly from `github.com/abeta-dev/kmp/bff@v0.2.0` wrapped in `github.com/abeta-dev/go-libs@v0.4.0` envelopes, serving as a drop-in dynamic BFF for `Abeta-dev/kmp` multiplatform apps across Android, iOS, macOS, Desktop JVM, WasmJS, watchOS, and Wear OS.

Run zero-config on `:8090` with pure-Go SQLite WAL (`go run ./cmd/layout-engine`) or PostgreSQL 17 (`docker compose up --build`). Ships with 6 pre-seeded multi-tenant vertical workspaces, all 17 canonical KMP v1 snippet templates, 13 deterministic targeting operators, UTC schedule windows, dynamic slotting, immutable versioned snapshots with rollback and automatic fallback failover, and a single-binary embedded Visual Layout Studio SPA at `GET /studio`.

When running locally or in production, this index and the full reference are also served live over HTTP at `GET /llms.txt` and `GET /llms-full.txt` (alongside `GET /openapi.json` and `GET /docs`).

## Documentation

- [Repository Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/README.md): Quick start, architecture diagram, 6 pre-seeded vertical workspaces, feature matrix, and API summary.
- [Full LLM Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/llms-full.txt): Single-file complete engineering reference covering Clean Architecture layers, all 17 KMP v1 snippet types, 13 targeting rule operators, dynamic slotting, context interpolation, snapshot governance, all 6 workspaces, full HTTP API surface, and quickstart commands.
- [Architecture & Persistence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/docs/architecture.md): Uncle Bob Dependency Rule, package responsibilities, 10 domain persistence ports, runtime page resolution pipeline, and dual SQLite / PostgreSQL 17 storage.
- [Visual Layout Studio, Rules & Slotting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/docs/studio-and-rules.md): Studio authoring lifecycle, pre-publish validation, RequestContext extraction, 13 rule operators, UTC schedule windows, dynamic slotting, and curl cookbook.
- [KMP Client Integration & Wire Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/docs/kmp-integration.md): Drop-in `--bff-url` setup for `Abeta-dev/kmp` clients, targeting headers, v1 wire contract parity, Brotli/ETag transport, and Room 3 offline failover synergy.

## AI Agent Contracts & Skills

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/AGENTS.md): Authoritative AI coding agent invariants, Clean Architecture boundaries, dual-database parity rules, and verification gates.
- [Abeta Layout Engine Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/layout-engine/main/skills/abeta-layout-engine/SKILL.md): Domain engineering skill for developing, testing, and operating the Layout Engine, transformer registry, Studio APIs, and persistence layers.

## Optional

- [Abeta KMP Kit (`Abeta-dev/kmp`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/kmp/main/llms.txt): Multiplatform Kotlin & Compose SDUI client kit (11 publishable libraries, Room 3 database, 17 snippet renderers, 18 action handlers, wearable companion, and canonical Go `pkg/sdui/*` v1 wire contracts).
- [Abeta SDUI BFF (`Abeta-dev/sdui-bff`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abeta-dev/sdui-bff/main/llms.txt): Companion Go SDUI Backend-for-Frontend ecosystem reference sharing the same `v1` wire contracts and `go-libs` envelope middleware.
